title: P1 Test Coverage Phase 1 - Core Security Modules
goal: Raise and verify Phase 1 automated test coverage for core authentication, IAM and audit modules with a reproducible CI gate.
week1Summary: Baseline measured; session package 11.2% -> 32.5% via new pure-logic tests; CI threshold intentionally not raised yet
week23Progress: 2026-09-08: pure-logic test pass for auth/login (2.4->8.1), iam/role (0.5->7.3), iam/permission (1.8->5.5), audit (6.5->26.5); DB-backed LoginService throttle tests verified against local MySQL (17/17 pass); DB-backed AuthHandler handler tests added (35/35 pass) pushing auth/login 52.0->67.9 (Phase-1 60% target MET); Redis-backed runtime tests enabled (previously silently skipping) - exposed and fixed a real production bug (MFA login response omitted user info) and a latent test-harness bug (secure_action middleware test never wired global Redis handle); auth/login 67.9->70.8, overall backend 57.4; full suite with MySQL+Redis: 39 packages ok, 0 failures; ALL Phase-1 module targets MET (auth 70.8>=60, iam 55.7-64.9>=50, audit 63.9>=50, overall 57.4>=30); CI threshold still not raised (needs MySQL service in ci.yml first - maintainer decision)
reconciliation: 2026-09-10 (task 0 coverage reconciliation, maintainer gate approved: add MySQL/Redis services to CI unit-tests job): CI unit-tests job now runs DB-backed (PANTHEON_TEST_DSN + PANTHEON_TEST_REDIS_ADDR services in .github/workflows/ci.yml). Re-measured DB-backed baseline (-short, per-package avg): auth/login 77.3%, auth/session 50.7%, auth/security 40.9%, iam/menu 67.1%, iam/permission 66.6%, iam/role 61.1%, iam/user 67.0%, audit 65.7%, overall 55.6%. CI backend coverage threshold raised 11 -> 50 (below measured value with headroom). Full DB-backed suite re-verified green under -race -short. Status aligned to done: all success criteria now verifiable through the CI gate (module targets met by DB-backed numbers; overall 55.6% >= 30).
